figure.purpose: The band's one figure, fitted to the column.

label.purpose: The band's and the rows' labels.

note.purpose: The one line under the figure.

motion.name: ease-lay
motion.purpose: Every transition and a layer's rise.

components.name: Band action
components.description: The band's one action: lime with a soot edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-inverse { --edge: 6px; width: 100%; height: 49px; margin-bottom: var(--edge); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--lime, #f4eee2); color: var(--soot, #1e1612); font: 700 17px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 105%; box-shadow: 0 var(--edge) 0 var(--soot, #1e1612); transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.25, 1), box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.25, 1); } .ds-btn-inverse:hover { background: #fbf8f1; transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #1e1612; } .ds-btn-inverse:active { transform: translateY(6px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #1e1612; } .ds-btn-inverse:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f4eee2; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sign button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { --edge: 6px; width: 100%; height: 52px; margin-bottom: var(--edge); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #b8452e; color: #f4eee2; font: 700 17px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 var(--edge) 0 #7a2a1b; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9c3822; transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #7a2a1b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b8452e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Secondary actions: wallet choices, disconnect, try again.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { width: 100%; height: 48px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #1e1612; font: 700 12px/1 'Martian Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 320ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #fbf8f1; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b8452e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Band chip
components.description: Outlined lime facts in the bar: network, language, wallet.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 6px; color: #f4eee2; font: 500 10px/1 'Martian Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: A failure in cold crimson with a drawn icon; a recovery button only where the screen has no other.
components.html: Phantom did not connect: the request was declined.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 14px; border: 2px solid #a3123a; border-radius: 7px; background: #fbf8f1; color: #a3123a; font: 600 14px/1.35 Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-notice p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Row
components.description: A label and value row under the band.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 65px; border-bottom: 2px solid #e6dccb; color: #1e1612; } .ds-row span { font: 500 13px 'Martian Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .ds-row strong { font: 900 38px Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 125%; }

narrative.overview: The app is one screen. A terracotta band owns the top of the phone and carries the one figure of the current state in giant cream Archivo; a course of kiln bricks closes the band, and a round rubber stamp, the Seal, rides that seam with the permission's state. Below, on lime, label and value rows are separated by sand rules. Everything else is a layer that opens above this screen and closes.
keyCharacteristics: Numbers first: the band's figure is the state; every figure carries its unit.
One screen, layers above it, no tabs and no navigation.
The band is the brand, never an alert: problems are cold crimson with a drawn icon, below the band.
Desktop centres the phone composition on full-bleed fields, never stretches it.
Every size is a hundredth of the column, so the phone's proportions hold at every width.

rules.name: The Band Is Not An Alert Rule
rules.body: The terracotta band states the state, including "unavailable" and "reading"; a failure is a crimson notice with a drawn icon in the rows, and the band stays as it was.

dos: Do put the state's one figure in the band, with its unit, fitted to the column.
Do stamp the permission state on the Seal at the seam: No permission, Active, Paused, Revoked, Unavailable.
Do open everything else as a layer above the one screen, and close it.
Do size everything in --u so the phone composition holds on desktop.
Do say a failure in crimson with a drawn icon and its recovery, under the band.
Do take tokens, fonts, buttons, chips, the Seal and brand marks from packages/ui; add a missing primitive there, as its own entry or variant.
donts: Don't colour the band for an error, a warning or a block.
Don't stretch the phone composition across a desktop, or give desktop a second layout.
Don't add tabs, cards, charts or badges to the screen.
Don't define a token, font, button, chip or seal style in the app.
Don't show a number without its unit, or a figure that could read as a return.
